description: Dialogue goals (packages/core/docs/dialogue-goals.md §3): what this world asks of a conversation, what it accepts as evidence, how much of that has been produced, and which quest step a satisfied goal discharges. Each kb mirrors packages/core/src/narrative/dialogue-predicates.ts verbatim and is regenerated by `npm run dialogue-corpus`. The pack is a COMPOSITION pack over the QUEST vocabulary: it reads quest_active/2, quest_objective/3 and conversational_action/4 and defines clauses for none of them, and the cases here declare every adopted predicate dynamic themselves, exactly as the shipped pack does, which is what lets them run standalone. Every number is an integer and there is no confidence, ratio or rounding anywhere in the pack — which is precisely what the v1 mechanic had and could not keep: ConversationGoalEvaluator scored a goal as matched.length / keywords.length rounded to two decimals and met at 0.5, or, with a provider wired, by asking a language model. The inversion is the module: a host supplies EVIDENCE (dialogue_cue_shown/3) and core supplies the verdict. What is NOT here is the quest itself: whether an objective is satisfied is objective_complete/3’s — 76 clauses of it in prolog/helper-predicates.ts, one of which already reads conversational_action/4 — so this pack deliberately adds no clause to it, and that a met goal advances a real quest through canonical KB state is proved end to end in packages/core/src/game-engine/logic/__tests__/DialogueDirector.test.ts. Neither is the gate on speaking: whether an actor MAY talk to somebody is one more clause of forbids/4, and permissible/3 belongs to conformance/prolog/agent-ai.json.

cases.name: a-bare-kb-asks-nothing-of-a-conversation-and-does-not-raise
kb: dialogue_sum([X | T], S) :- dialogue_sum(T, S0), S is S0 + X.
dialogue_goal_score(A, G, S) :- nonvar(A), dialogue_goal(G), findall(W, (dialogue_cue_shown(A, G, C), dialogue_cue(G, C, W)), Ws), dialogue_sum(Ws, S).
dialogue_goal_met(A, G) :- dialogue_goal_threshold(G, Need), dialogue_goal_score(A, G, S), S >= Need.
dialogue_goal_short(A, G, Short) :- dialogue_goal_threshold(G, Need), dialogue_goal_score(A, G, S), S < Need, Short is Need - S.
dialogue_goal_discharged(A, G) :- dialogue_goal_act(G, Act), dialogue_goal_quest(G, Q, _), conversational_action(A, _, Act, Q).
dialogue_goal_live(A, G) :- dialogue_goal_quest(G, Q, Idx), quest_active(A, Q), quest_objective(Q, Idx, _), \+ dialogue_goal_discharged(A, G).
can_advance_dialogue(A, G, Npc) :- nonvar(A), dialogue_goal(G), dialogue_goal_addressee(G, Npc), dialogue_goal_live(A, G).
dialogue_goal_pending(A, G) :- dialogue_goal_met(A, G), dialogue_goal_live(A, G).

dialogue_goal_score(A, G, S) :- nonvar(A), dialogue_goal(G), findall(W, (dialogue_cue_shown(A, G, C), dialogue_cue(G, C, W)), Ws), dialogue_sum(Ws, S).
dialogue_goal_met(A, G) :- dialogue_goal_threshold(G, Need), dialogue_goal_score(A, G, S), S >= Need.
dialogue_goal_short(A, G, Short) :- dialogue_goal_threshold(G, Need), dialogue_goal_score(A, G, S), S < Need, Short is Need - S.
dialogue_goal_discharged(A, G) :- dialogue_goal_act(G, Act), dialogue_goal_quest(G, Q, _), conversational_action(A, _, Act, Q).
dialogue_goal_live(A, G) :- dialogue_goal_quest(G, Q, Idx), quest_active(A, Q), quest_objective(Q, Idx, _), \+ dialogue_goal_discharged(A, G).
can_advance_dialogue(A, G, Npc) :- nonvar(A), dialogue_goal(G), dialogue_goal_addressee(G, Npc), dialogue_goal_live(A, G).
dialogue_goal_pending(A, G) :- dialogue_goal_met(A, G), dialogue_goal_live(A, G).
